Looking at the verification errors, the issue is that when we recursively call `Prove(s[1..])`, we need to establish that `K.Clean(s[1..])` holds. This requires calling `O.TailInvariant(s)` before the recursive call.

The `TailInvariant` lemma in `Ops.dfy` states:
```dafny
lemma TailInvariant(s: seq<int>)
  requires K.Clean(s) && 2 <= |s|
  ensures K.Clean(s[1..])
```

So in the `else` branch (where `|s| >= 2`), we need to:
1. First call `O.TailInvariant(s)` to establish `K.Clean(s[1..])`
2. Then make the recursive call `Prove(s[1..])`
3. Then call `O.Boundary(s)` and `O.Keep(s)`

```json
{
  "HelperA.dfy": "if |s| < 2 {\n      O.Base(s);\n    } else {\n      O.TailInvariant(s);\n      Prove(s[1..]);\n      O.Boundary(s);\n      O.Keep(s);\n      assert s == [s[0]] + s[1..];\n    }",
  "HelperB.dfy": "if |s| < 2 {\n      O.Base(s);\n    } else {\n      O.TailInvariant(s);\n      Prove(s[1..]);\n      O.Boundary(s);\n      O.Keep(s);\n      assert s == [s[0]] + s[1..];\n    }"
}
```
